Step three of the sign-in form: the account's licenses with their tier and seat meter, full licenses without a radio, Replace a device as a step in place, and the key field. License origins are described in plain words, and a grant that expires while the step is open returns to sign-in.

## In each kit

No kit documents LicenseChoice here yet. Each kit adds its tab when it ships the component: the drop-in,
the styled part with its slots and restyle hooks, and the headless model.
